title: Palabichos
summary: A mobile-first browser arcade game that reinforces Spanish vocabulary through play.
purpose: Provide an approachable game experience in which repeated play supports Spanish vocabulary practice.
responsibilities: Deliver the browser game interface and gameplay loop.
Present Spanish vocabulary as part of the play experience.
Own the application-specific game state and player interactions.
boundaries: Does not provide a reusable game engine package.
Does not own general-purpose language-learning contracts or content services.
Does not expose its application behavior as a published library API.
audience: Spanish learners who want lightweight vocabulary practice in a browser.
useCases: Play a short mobile-friendly vocabulary arcade session.
Practice recognizing Spanish vocabulary through repeated game interactions.

architecture.role: Standalone React browser application that composes game presentation, interactions, and vocabulary content.
invariants: The application remains independently buildable and deployable.
Game-specific behavior stays within the application rather than being presented as a reusable platform contract.

platforms: Modern web browsers with JavaScript enabled.
